db/migrations/0002_orders.sql:2 Both SQL migrations have no down step and are not marked one-way. db/migrations/0001_safe.sql and 0002_orders.sql contain only forward statements (add column, index, constraints). No down section, no paired down file, and no comment saying the migration is one-way. The alembic and Django migrations in the same change do ship reverse steps. 0002 is deployed and the FK validation or the new index causes trouble in production. To roll back, an operator has to hand-write DROP CONSTRAINT orders_customer_fk, DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY orders_customer_idx and DROP COLUMN tracking_code under pressure. If 0002 failed part-way, nothing in the repo says which statements already committed, since CONCURRENTLY statements cannot sit in a rollback-able transaction.
